name: INTRO TO  SEWING  CLOTHES: Make a Flow Top!
description:
What does an embodied making of clothes look like? How might such a making of clothes in collective spirit honour joyful learning? Where might this making lead us?

In this session, we will together explore how you can make a top that you can wear as you like. Away from standard measurement templates, we will instead think with the body and unpack what (fun)ctionality in clothes can feel like and offer.

As we engage in this session, you will also learn the basics of pattern making, seam work, and garment construction, all while making the process yours and only yours.

Beginners are welcome.

All material will be provided.

name: Pint of View Lecture Over Drinks: Ctrl + Alt + Infringe—Intellectual Property in the Age of AI
description:
**About the event**

We use AI to write, design, make videos, edit photographs and even polish our Instagram captions. We are all eager participants in this new creative revolution. But have you ever wondered: Who owns the copyright to something you create using AI?

AI models are trained on enormous amounts of human-created work scraped from across the internet. So, who owns the intellectual property used to train these models? Is there copyright infringement when machines learn from human creativity? And when AI creates something new, who owns the output?

Join us for a fascinating deep dive into the collision between artificial intelligence and intellectual property, exploring copyright, patents, authorship, licensing and the economics of innovation.

**About the Speaker**

Anu Vaidyanathan is a filmmaker, comedian, engineer and entrepreneur. She is the founder of PatNMarks, an intellectual property firm working at the intersection of technology and innovation. With a PhD in Electrical and Computer Engineering, she is also the first Asian woman to complete Ultraman Canada, an extraordinary endurance achievement. She is the author of the bestselling memoir *Anywhere But Home,* and has worked across independent filmmaking, screenwriting and stand-up comedy, performing internationally.

Expect intellectual property, AI and a generous dose of Anu's wry humour.

**Event Details**

📅 Saturday, 7 November 2026

⏰ 4 PM – 6 PM

📍 Bangalore Local, Koramangala, Bengaluru

**Your ticket includes:**

• 1 complimentary kombucha from Local Ferment Co.

• First-come, first-served seating

**About Pint of View**

Pint of View is India's Largest Lecture Community. We brought the lecture in bar format to India and are now expanding across the globe with chapters in 16 cities worldwide. Here, big ideas meet intimate spaces, and you walk in curious and walk out with a sharper lens on the world.

Book now and develop your own pint of view. 🍻

name: Lino Printing Workshop with Aparna Konat!
description:
This hands-on workshop introduces the basics of lino cut printmaking, from carving a simple design to inking and printing your own artwork. Participants will be guided through the process step by step and will leave with their own prints, perfect as small artworks or gifts.

The session runs for **three hours** and includes demonstrations, supported making time, and space to experiment.

Open to beginners and anyone curious about printmaking — no prior experience needed. Suitable for ages 14+.

**What should I bring?**

Clothes you don’t mind getting messy in, ideas or finished sketches for designs (found images from books are welcome), and lots of creativity.

**What’s provided?**

All printing tools, paper, and inks will be provided.

**What do I take home?**

All finished artworks are yours to keep, along with any unfinished pieces. Participants will also keep their carved lino block, allowing them to reprint at home with basic supplies.

**What's included**

- Lino sheet
- Lino carving tool
- Lino ink
- 140gsm paper
- Baren
- Roller
